description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2920015494623 STARTER,ENGINE,ELEC: Line 0001 Qty 56 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0047 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
